pattern_source.says: Physics 45 (180 marks), Chemistry 45 (180), 'Biology (Botany & Zoology)' 90 (360); 180 compulsory MCQs, 720 marks, 180 minutes, pen and paper. Correct +4, incorrect -1, unanswered 0.

sections.botany_zoology_split: The bulletin names Botany and Zoology but gives no per-section question count and does not say which syllabus content belongs to which. The 45 + 45 split is NOT stated in the bulletin; confirm it from an official question paper.

source.applies_to_2026_because: NEET (UG) 2026 Information Bulletin, FAQ on the syllabus (PDF p.81, printed p.76), Q2: 'No, there is no change in the syllabus of NEET (UG) - 2026 with respect to the previous year.' The bulletin's Appendix-III (PDF pp.65-80) reproduces the syllabus as images; pages here refer to the standalone syllabus PDF.

structure.rule: subject -> unit -> chapter. A unit is NTA's 'UNIT n'. Physics and Chemistry units are not subdivided by NTA, so each has one chapter with the same name. Biology units ARE subdivided by NTA into bulleted blocks; each bullet is a chapter.
structure.biology_chapter_names: name_source says where each name comes from: 'nta_subheading' = NTA's own words leading the bullet; 'ncert_title' = the bullet has no heading of its own, so it is named after the NCERT chapter it corresponds to. nta_text_start is the bullet's first words, verbatim.
structure.paper_section: Every Biology chapter carries paper_section = Botany or Zoology. basis 'content' = the NTA text itself is plant-only or animal/human-only. basis 'convention' = it is not, and the assignment follows coaching convention; verify each one by counting where its questions sit in NTA's published papers.
structure.name: NTA's wording, re-cased for display; name_verbatim is exactly as printed.
structure.weight: Not recorded. Chapter weights will be counted from past papers, not estimated.

ncert.edition: Rationalised textbooks, 'Reprint 2026-27' (printed on every page of the files checked)
ncert.how_verified: Every chapter number, title and PDF link was checked by downloading the chapter PDF from ncert.nic.in on 2026-10-07 and reading its opening page: the printed heading for 104 of the 106 files; for keph107 (Gravitation) and lech104 (d- and f-Block) the heading is an image, so the opening text was read instead. File checksums and headings: data/raw/syllabus/ncert/chapter_pdf_check.tsv; book contents pages: data/raw/syllabus/ncert/*ps.pdf.

ambiguities.what: The document is titled 'SYLLABUS FOR NEET (UG) - 2025' although NTA links it as the syllabus on the NEET 2026 site (uploaded Jan 2026). The 2026 bulletin's FAQ says the syllabus is unchanged from the previous year, so it is used as the 2026 syllabus.
Says '... of an insect (Frog)'. The 2026 bulletin FAQ (PDF p.81, Q4) says it should be read as 'of an insect and a frog'.
Begins 'B Cell division' — a stray 'B'. Read as 'Cell division'.
'Organisms and environmentPopulation interactions' — separator missing in the PDF. Chapter named 'Organisms and environment'.
Seven bullets carry no heading of their own; they are named after the NCERT chapter they correspond to (name_source = 'ncert_title').

Biology is 90 questions as 'Biology (Botany & Zoology)'. NTA states no 45/45 split and no mapping of syllabus content to Botany or Zoology. The section on each Biology chapter is therefore marked 'content' or 'convention', never 'official'.
Named 'Physics and Measurement' here and 'Units and Measurements' in the JEE Main 2026 syllabus for nearly identical content. Each file keeps its own exam's wording.

The NMC link the bulletin gives for the syllabus (nmc.org.in/MCIRest/open/getDocument?path=.../Public%20Notice_NEET_removed.pdf) returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-07; the NMC copy was not obtained. The NTA-hosted copy is used.
